source: Full-network rescope 4 Sep 2026 (Luke). National Rail: ORR Table 6329 'Station attributes for all mainline stations, Great Britain, as at 31 March 2026' (https://dataportal.orr.gov.uk/statistics/infrastructure-and-environment/rail-infrastructure-and-assets/table-6329-station-attributes-for-all-mainline-stations/), filtered to Combined authority = Liverpool City Region. Merseyrail: same ORR 6329 table, filtered to Station facility owner = Merseyrail, plus Chester (Wirral Line terminus, TfW Rail-owned facility) and Liverpool Lime Street's Merseyrail presence (Network Rail-owned facility) to reach the oracle report's confirmed 69-station total. Coordinates: NaPTAN RailReferences.csv + access-nodes CSV (CRS -> ATCO -> lat/lng), same method as scripts/lib/uk-naptan.mjs (West Midlands precedent). Original pack: docs/liverpool-city-region-d1/published-network.json (Nico oracle-clash-report + Luke's D1 pack, 1 Sep 2026).
notes: RESCOPED 4 Sep 2026: full-network rescope from the original 6-station D1 pack (2 National Rail + 4 named Merseyrail stations) to the full Liverpool City Region + Merseyrail network - 29 National Rail stations (Combined authority = Liverpool City Region per ORR Table 6329) + 68 Merseyrail stations (Station facility owner = Merseyrail per the same table, plus Chester; Lime Street's Merseyrail presence folded into the single mode-train Lime Street entry, see H1-closed note below) = 97 total. See docs/liverpool-city-region-d1/rescope-addendum.md for full before/after detail and sourcing.
National Rail (Darwin/OpenLDBWS) is structurally catalogued here but blocked at the account level - DARWIN_LDB_TOKEN not set. Same blocker as every other UK region in this wave.

MERSEYRAIL REAL-TIME CORRECTED 4 Sep 2026 (supersedes the 2 Sep out-product verdict below): Merseyrail is a National Rail train operating company, not a metro system without a public feed - its stations carry CRS codes and its services are served by Darwin/OpenLDBWS exactly like any other TOC. Probed 4 Sep 2026 (ELP, LVC, MRF, LIV all returned live Merseyrail trips with platform + status). fetchMerseyrailStopBoard() in lib/providers/liverpool-city-region.js now calls Darwin via fetchStationBoard()'s entry/mode passthrough, the same shared path as National Rail. Board-eligibility verdict is now in (docs/liverpool-city-region-d1/oracle-clash-report.md Board eligibility section, dated correction). No operator filters are applied anywhere in this region - every board shows every operator Darwin returns for that CRS. HISTORICAL, superseded: static GTFS was confirmed live via Transitland (f-gc-rail~delivery~group~planar~gtfs, verified 2026-08-31) while real-time was believed genuinely unconfirmed - no public GTFS-RT endpoint was found, only an undocumented mobile-app ("Train Check") internal API. That search was the wrong lens (GTFS-RT, not Darwin) and the out-product verdict it produced was wrong; see the 4 Sep correction above.

TWO SEPARATE AGENCY STRUCTURES, NOT ONE SHARED HUB: National Rail hub lock Liverpool Lime Street (LIV), secondary hub Liverpool South Parkway (LPY). Merseyrail's own interchange pair is Liverpool Central and Moorfields - neither ranked above the other by the report. See docs/liverpool-city-region-d1/hazard-pack.md H6.

LIME STREET STRUCTURAL AMBIGUITY (H1) - CLOSED AS MOOT 4 Sep 2026 (Tim's option B): the two-stationGroup / doNotGroup split carried from the D1 pack is removed. One Darwin CRS (LIV), one board, platform numbers (including Merseyrail's low-level platform "A") on every train Darwin returns - the "same building or two" question does not matter once there is one board with platforms. HISTORICAL, carried for record: the D1 pack built two separate stationGroups (mode train Liverpool Lime Street and mode metro Liverpool Lime Street) with doNotGroup: true, because the oracle report contradicted itself on whether Merseyrail's Northern/Wirral Line presence at Lime Street shares platforms with National Rail ("platform level", report line 41) or is separate infrastructure connected by footbridge (report line 73, C2/C3 point 2). See docs/liverpool-city-region-d1/hazard-pack.md H1.

ELLESMERE PORT REGISTRY DISCREPANCY - RESOLVED 2 Sep 2026: the standalone uk-ellesmere-port registry.js entry was deleted. This catalog's Ellesmere Port entry (mode metro, catalogId merseyrail:ellesmere-port) is unchanged in identity, now sourced from ORR Table 6329 + NaPTAN instead of the oracle report's prose.

Merseyrail Northern Line vs Wirral Line membership is NOT individually asserted per station in this file (no 'line' field on most metro stops) - ORR Table 6329 does not carry a route/line column, and no GTFS route/stop_times data was pulled (Transitland's REST API requires an API key this pipeline does not have; the public feed browse page has no no-key static download link). Only stations individually named by the oracle report (Liverpool Central, Moorfields - dual-line interchange; Ellesmere Port, West Kirby, Chester - Wirral Line termini; Southport, Ormskirk, Headbolt Lane - Northern Line termini) carry a line note. This is a real, flagged gap - see hazard-pack.md H3 and jim-handoff.md. Do not infer line membership for the remaining ~60 stations from geography or borough name.

lat/lng are now populated for every station via NaPTAN (RailReferences.csv CRS->ATCO join + access-nodes CSV ATCO->lat/lng), the same method scripts/lib/uk-naptan.mjs uses for West Midlands. This closes the 'lat/lng null for every station' gap flagged in the original pack's header.
'borough' field is the ORR Table 6329 'Local authority: district or unitary' column value at the 31 Mar 2026 snapshot - informational only, not used for any doNotGroup or hub-lock decision.

stops.name: Liverpool Lime Street
stops.class: National Rail hub lock - main terminus, seven TOCs (Northern Trains primary franchise; Avanti West Coast, TransPennine Express, East Midlands Railway, Transport for Wales, West Midlands Trains, CrossCountry through-running) plus Merseyrail low-level platforms (platform "A"), all on one Darwin board (CRS LIV). H1 closed as moot 4 Sep 2026 - see notes.

stops.name: Liverpool South Parkway
stops.class: National Rail secondary hub - airport connector (Liverpool John Lennon Airport), regional and long-distance services. Not a shared-building/doNotGroup case with Merseyrail in this pack's architecture (see hazard-pack.md H6), though ORR Table 6329 (31 Mar 2026) lists its Station facility owner as Merseyrail (joint station, Merseyrail's Northern Line also calls here) - flagged as a minor architecture note, not resolved as a doNotGroup split without a walk-distance/platform-separation figure the way Lime Street's H1 has.
